_about: Don's taste profile: the rubric Claude's daily review applies before approving any deal or pick, and where Don's feedback is kept. The review adds to rejected, loved and feedback_log from 'Capsule nope' emails (the Not for me links) and replies to The Drop, and turns repeat lessons into rules in finder.json. The scraper doesn't read this file.
look: Elevated 90s/00s retro and workwear through a mature, deliberate lens. Effortless and put-together: fewer pieces, better fit, tonal outfits, texture over branding. Not trend-chasing streetwear, not skate, not fashion-week.
build: 6ft, about 190lb, athletic but carries weight at the midsection, long arms (sleeves must reach the wrist). Tops L (outerwear L-XL), trousers W34 L32 with stretch, shoes UK 10.
palette: Charcoal, navy, olive, stone, taupe, washed blue, plus oatmeal or ecru knits and grey marl sweats. Tonal pairings. No black, brown or bright clothing; brown is fine for footwear (brushed leather or suede boots, Wallabees).
yes: Utility jackets: chore, field or M-65, harrington, waxed cotton, overshirts in olive, stone or navy
Knits: crew necks with texture (waffle, cable, honeycomb), shawl or ribbed cardigans, fitted quarter-zip or mock-neck fleece
Plain midweight sweats and hoodies with a 90s runner's fit (not drop-shoulder)
Chinos with stretch, straight to slightly tapered; jeans straight or tapered, mid-rise, indigo or washed blue

Footwear he likes: adidas Samba-style (Samba, Gazelle, Spezial), Vans Era, Nike SB Janoski and Blazer, Air Max 90, New Balance 990/574-type in muted tones, Clarks Wallabee, and Chelsea boots with a sleek or chunky sole (he likes the John White Byrne style)
Already owns: white Sambas, brown and black Dr. Martens, black/white Vans Era, black Air Max 95, a 5-panel cap
Leather is fine for footwear: brushed-leather boots and leather trainers; fur, shearling or fleece-lined trainers and boots are fine for winter
Shoe and boot finishes: brushed, grained or suede leather
no: Any visible logo, graphic, slogan or contrast branding (a tiny tonal mark is the limit)
Oversized, boxy, drop-shoulder, wide-leg, baggy, cropped or skinny cuts; chunky knits that add bulk at the middle
Leather (or faux leather/suede) jackets, tees or trousers, blazers and other dressy fashion pieces; leather only belongs on his feet
Skate shoes with loud stripes or logos, chunky or platform soles on trainers (chunky boots are fine), slim low-profile trend trainers, collabs
Busy patterns: stripes, checks, fair isle, boro, botanical prints, float-stitch, fluffy mohair
Black, brown, tan or bright colours on clothing
Shiny, polished or patent leather on shoes and boots
